h1: How many parking spaces are required for single- and two-family homes in Newton, MA?
title: Newton Residential Parking Requirements: Single- and Two-Family Homes
description: Review Newton's published minimum parking requirement and check the separate restrictions on where spaces may be located.
short_answer: Newton's current parking table lists 2 parking stalls per unit for a single-family or two-family dwelling. Separate zoning rules control where parking stalls may be placed, including limits within required street and side-yard setbacks. Confirm the rules for the property's exact zoning district and site layout.

facts.text: Newton's parking table lists 2 parking stalls per unit for a single-family or two-family dwelling.
Newton's zoning ordinance separately regulates parking stalls within required street and side-lot-line setbacks.

qa.q: Does the 2-per-unit rule mean all spaces can be placed in the front yard?
qa.a: No. The required parking count and the rules governing where spaces may be placed are separate zoning questions.
